title: Block loop state transition
statement: Given update and next-state functions on pairs of Boolean lists and an encoded state $s$, decode its outer pair. If the first component is empty, return the completed-block marker. Otherwise, decode the second component; if its first component is empty, also return the completed-block marker. In every other case, encode a new outer pair: its first component is the update function applied to the first component of $s$ and the second component of the decoded inner pair; its second component encodes the inner first component with its first entry removed, paired with the next-state function applied to those same inputs.
hypotheses_covered: The update and next-state functions each take two Boolean lists and return a Boolean list
